Notes: *p < 0.1, **p < 0.01, ***p < 0.001. 

In the invented district sample, the weekly tutoring coefficient on the synthetic math score shrinks once prior scores enter the model. Model 3 adds the placeholder household index, and the estimate stays positive but is no longer significant. For the invented reading measure, more tutoring sessions predict higher scores in every specification. These fabricated results exist only to exercise the passage parser (Example and Sample 2020).
